Stop one to six

One table, one evening, six stops

Dinner here runs from a first glass to the walk home. Set a party size and arrival time to see an example pace, then send it with your request.

Party size
  1. -

    Arrive

    Menus, a first glass, bread. Nobody is rushing you to order.

    Arrive a few minutes early if you want a drink at the bar first.

  2. -

    Antipasti

    A plate or two for the middle of the table while the pasta is made to order.

    Two plates is plenty for four people. Add more once you see the table.

  3. -

    Pasta

    Order as soon as the antipasti land so it comes straight from the pan.

    Share one cacio e pepe and one ragu so everyone tries both.

  4. -

    The oven

    A roasted plate to share, fish, chicken or whatever the oven is doing.

    The whole branzino is for two or more, so order it with the pasta.

  5. -

    Dolci

    Dessert and an after-dinner pour, or just the pour.

    One tiramisu and extra spoons is a fine plan.

  6. -

    Walk home

    Last call, the check and your coat. The dining room closes at 11.

    Ask for the check with dessert if you have a babysitter or a train.

Questions people ask

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes, when tables are open. The bar seats walk-ins without a request, and a few tables are held each night. Requests are given first pick of tables. This is sample policy for a made-up restaurant.

Can you cook for allergies or a vegetarian guest?

Tell us in your request or at the table and the kitchen will say what it can do. V and VG on the menu mark vegetarian and vegan plates. We cannot rule out cross-contact with allergens.

Can you seat a large group or host a private dinner?

For seven or more, or a private dinner, send a request with the date, head count and any needs. We will reply with what is possible and what it would cost.

Is there parking, and is the room accessible?

Street and garage parking are nearby, and the entrance is step-free. These are placeholders for the sample. A live site would show the exact lot and the route in.

Can I change or cancel a request?

Yes. Reply to our confirmation or call, and tell us as early as you can so the table can go to someone else.

Do you have high chairs, and is there a dress code?

High chairs are available, and there is a plain tomato spaghetti for small appetites. There is no dress code. Come as you are.

Not here?

Call and ask us anything about the menu or the room.
